# Rage: Clay Demo

> An offline Windows incremental clay platformer demo: six districts, eight permanent upgrades, new enemies, and a two-phase Kiln King. MIT-licensed C# expansion; original game assets/runtime retain their own licenses.

## Play
- [Latest playable Windows ZIP](https://github.com/Natex-corporation/gamejam3-rage/releases/latest/download/Rage-Clay-Demo-Windows-x64.zip)
- [Machine-readable manifest](https://github.com/Natex-corporation/gamejam3-rage/blob/main/demo-manifest.json)
- [Checksums](https://github.com/Natex-corporation/gamejam3-rage/releases/latest/download/SHA256SUMS.txt)
- [Controls and game guide](https://github.com/Natex-corporation/gamejam3-rage/blob/main/PLAYING.md)
